IC1: Subject has been diagnosed with symptomatic paroxysmal atrial fibrillation [AND] as defined above and at least two symptomatic episodes in the last six months prior to inclusion.
IC2: At least one episode  [AND]of AF must be documented during the prior year by any kind of ECG recording.
IC3: Subject has structural normal heart w [AND]ith an LVEF = 50%, thickness of the inter-ventricular septum =12 mm and left atrium diameters (short axis) < 46 mm obtained by transthoracic echocardiography.
IC4: Subject has normal ECG parameters (QRS width in the 12 channel surface ECG =120 ms, QTc - interval < 440 ms, PQ - interval = 210 ms; all parameters should be measured at sinus rhythm).
IC5: Subject is at least 18 and not older than 75years old.
IC6: Subject is able and willing to give informed consent.
